# 1. LOAD & FILTER

```{r}

stat <- read.csv("Ess_data/LF_Biomass_Abund.csv")

# need to exclude deep water shelf edge strata, I think the ones to include are 440–466 
# but we can change as needed depending on what Alida suggests as there might be a good 
# reason to exclude 4Vn which are strata 440-442  ).
# ─────────────────────────────────────────────
# 2. WIDE BIOMASS TABLE
# ─────────────────────────────────────────────
biomass_wide <- stat %>%
  filter(!is.na(STRAT), STRAT != "") %>%
  filter(suppressWarnings(as.numeric(STRAT)) >= 440,
         suppressWarnings(as.numeric(STRAT)) <= 466) %>%
  filter(SPEC < 1000) %>%
  group_by(YEAR, COMMON_NAME) %>%
  summarise(
    Biomass_Strata_KG = sum(Biomass_Strata_KG, na.rm = TRUE),
    .groups = "drop") %>%
  pivot_wider(
    names_from  = COMMON_NAME,
    values_from = Biomass_Strata_KG,
    values_fill = 0) %>% arrange(YEAR)
write.csv(biomass_wide, "Ess_data/DFO_Biomas_all_species", row.names = FALSE)


```



# 3. PHASE LABELS  — single source of truth
```{r}

PHASE_REF  <- "1978–1992 (Reference Period)"         # FIX #3: explicit en-dash unicode
PHASE_POST <- "1993-2025 (Unconstrained Period)"    # FIX #3: explicit en-dash unicode

# ─────────────────────────────────────────────
# 4. LONG PHASE DATA
# ─────────────────────────────────────────────
long_df_phase <- biomass_wide %>%
  filter(between(YEAR, 1970, 2025)) %>%
  mutate(Phase = factor(
    if_else(YEAR <= 1992, PHASE_REF, PHASE_POST),
    levels = c(PHASE_REF, PHASE_POST)
  )) %>%
  pivot_longer(-c(YEAR, Phase), names_to = "Species", values_to = "BIOMASS") %>%
  filter(!is.na(BIOMASS), BIOMASS > 0) %>%
  group_by(Species) %>%
  filter(n() >= 5) %>%
  ungroup()

# ─────────────────────────────────────────────
# 5. PHASE PERCENTAGE SUMMARY
# ─────────────────────────────────────────────
phase_pct <- long_df_phase %>%                                   # FIX #4: removed redundant filter(YEAR>=1970)
  group_by(Phase, Species) %>%
  summarise(BIOMASS = sum(BIOMASS), .groups = "drop") %>%
  group_by(Phase) %>%
  mutate(Pct = BIOMASS / sum(BIOMASS)) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  arrange(Phase, desc(Pct)) %>%
  group_by(Phase) %>%
  mutate(
    Rank   = row_number(),
    CumPct = cumsum(Pct)) %>%
  filter(is.finite(Pct)) %>%
  mutate(Species = str_to_sentence(str_squish(Species))) %>%
  ungroup()

# ─────────────────────────────────────────────
# 6. COLOUR PALETTE  — keyed to phase constants
# ─────────────────────────────────────────────
pal <- setNames(                                                  # FIX #3: use setNames to guarantee matching
  c("#E07B2A", "#2471A3"),
  c(PHASE_REF, PHASE_POST)
)

# ─────────────────────────────────────────────
# 7. PLOT FUNCTION
# ─────────────────────────────────────────────
make_phase_plot <- function(ph, df = phase_pct) {
  col <- pal[[ph]]
  df_ph <- df %>%
    filter(Phase == ph) %>%
    mutate(Species = factor(Species, levels = rev(unique(Species))))
  
  # 95% cumulative cut-off
  cut_rank <- df_ph %>%
    filter(CumPct >= 0.95) %>%                                   # FIX #5: align threshold with label
    slice(1) %>%
    pull(Rank)
  
  if (length(cut_rank) == 0 || !is.finite(cut_rank)) cut_rank <- nrow(df_ph)
  
  df_ph <- df_ph %>%
    mutate(Above95 = Rank <= cut_rank)
  
  # FIX #6: derive ypos from factor levels to get correct visual position
  cut_species <- as.character(df_ph$Species[df_ph$Rank == cut_rank][1])
  ypos <- which(levels(df_ph$Species) == cut_species) - 0.5
  
  ggplot(df_ph, aes(Pct, Species)) +
    annotate("rect",
             xmin = -Inf, xmax = Inf, ymin = ypos, ymax = Inf,
             fill = col, alpha = 0.06) +
    geom_col(aes(alpha = Above95),
             fill = col, colour = "white", linewidth = 0.2, width = 0.85) +
    scale_alpha_manual(values = c("TRUE" = 0.85, "FALSE" = 0.35), guide = "none") +
    geom_hline(yintercept = ypos, colour = col, linetype = "dashed", linewidth = 0.7) +
    annotate("label",
             x = Inf, y = ypos,
             label   = "\u2190 95% cumulative biomass",
             colour  = col, fill = "white",
             label.padding = unit(0.18, "lines"),
             hjust = 1.05, vjust = -0.3,
             size = 2.6, fontface = "bold") +
    scale_x_continuous(
      labels = percent_format(accuracy = 1),
      expand = expansion(mult = c(0, 0.30))
    ) +
    labs(title = ph, x = "% of total biomass", y = NULL) +
    theme_classic(base_size = 10, base_family = "serif") +
    theme(
      panel.border       = element_rect(colour = col, fill = NA, linewidth = 1.1),
      plot.background    = element_rect(fill = "white", colour = col, linewidth = 0.4),
      plot.title         = element_text(face = "bold", size = 10, colour = col,
                                        margin = margin(b = 6)),
      axis.text.y        = element_text(size = 7.5, colour = "grey15"),
      axis.text.x        = element_text(size = 7.0, colour = "grey40"),
      axis.title.x       = element_text(size = 7.5, colour = "grey40", margin = margin(t = 4)),
      axis.ticks         = element_line(colour = "grey70", linewidth = 0.3),
      axis.line          = element_blank(),
      panel.grid.major.x = element_line(colour = "grey92", linewidth = 0.3),
      panel.grid.major.y = element_blank(),
      panel.grid.minor   = element_blank(),
      plot.margin        = margin(10, 16, 10, 10))
}

```

## CLUSTER PLOT
```{r}

# ─────────────────────────────────────────────
# 4. PREPARE MATRIX
# ─────────────────────────────────────────────
long_wide <- biomass_wide %>% filter(!YEAR %in% c(2018, 2021, 2022)) # outliers
years     <- long_wide$YEAR
pl.data   <- long_wide %>% select(-YEAR)
pl.data   <- as.data.frame(lapply(pl.data, as.numeric))
rownames(pl.data) <- years

# ── 5. REMOVE SPECIES PRESENT IN FEWER THAN 2 YEARS ──
pl.data[is.na(pl.data)] <- 0
pl.data <- pl.data[, colSums(pl.data > 0) >= 2]

# ── 6. PCA ──
pl.data.log <- log1p(pl.data)
res.pca     <- prcomp(pl.data.log, center = TRUE, scale. = TRUE)
PoV         <- res.pca$sdev^2 / sum(res.pca$sdev^2)

# ── 7. SCORES + CLUSTERING ──
pca_2d         <- res.pca$x[, 1:2]
scores         <- as.data.frame(res.pca$x)
scores$Year    <- as.integer(rownames(scores))
d              <- dist(pca_2d, method = "euclidean")
hc             <- hclust(d, method = "ward.D2")
scores$Cluster <- factor(cutree(hc, k = 2))

# ── 8. PLOT ──
cluster_colours <- c("1" = "#2166AC", "2" = "#D6604D")

p <- ggplot(scores, aes(PC1, PC2)) +
  stat_ellipse(aes(fill = Cluster, color = Cluster),
  geom = "polygon",alpha     = 0.08,linetype  = "dashed", linewidth = 0.4) +
  geom_point(aes(color = Cluster), shape = 16,size  = 2, alpha = 0.85) +
  geom_text_repel(aes(label = Year, color = Cluster),
  size = 2.9, fontface  = "bold",max.overlaps  = 50,box.padding   = 0.35,segment.color = NA, show.legend   = FALSE) +
  scale_color_manual(values = cluster_colours, name = "Cluster") +
  scale_fill_manual(values  = cluster_colours, guide = "none") +
  labs(
    x = paste0("PC1  (", round(PoV[1] * 100, 1), "% variance explained)"),
    y = paste0("PC2  (", round(PoV[2] * 100, 1), "% variance explained)")) +
  theme_classic(base_size = 13) +
  theme(
    axis.title       = element_text(face = "bold"),
    axis.text        = element_text(color = "black"),
    legend.title     = element_text(face = "bold", size = 10),
    legend.text      = element_text(size = 9),
    legend.position  = "right",
    panel.border     = element_rect(colour = "grey70", fill = NA, linewidth = 0.6),
    plot.background  = element_blank(),
    plot.margin      = margin(12, 12, 12, 12))
p

ggsave("Ess_data/species_cluster.jpeg", plot   = p, width  = 14, height = 10, dpi    = 300,device = "jpeg")

```


# CHANGEPOINT ANALYSIS 
```{r}
# ── CHANGEPOINT ANALYSIS ─────────────────────────────────────
library(trend)
library(segmented)
library(ggplot2)
library(patchwork)

# ── 1. BUILD YEAR SCORES FROM PRCOMP OUTPUT ──────────────────
# Note: 2018, 2021, 2022 already excluded at PCA stage
year_scores        <- as.data.frame(res.pca$x[, 1:2])
colnames(year_scores) <- c("Dim.1", "Dim.2")
year_scores$Year   <- as.integer(rownames(year_scores))

# ── 2. CLEAN DATA ─────────────────────────────────────────────
df_clean  <- year_scores |> dplyr::select(year = Year, dim1 = Dim.1)
df2_clean <- year_scores |> dplyr::select(year = Year, dim2 = Dim.2)

# Quick sanity check
cat("Rows:", nrow(df_clean),
    "| Years:", min(df_clean$year), "to", max(df_clean$year),
    "| NAs:", sum(is.na(df_clean$dim1)), "\n")

# ── 3. MANN-KENDALL TESTS ─────────────────────────────────────
mk1 <- mk.test(ts(df_clean$dim1,  start = min(df_clean$year)))
mk2 <- mk.test(ts(df2_clean$dim2, start = min(df2_clean$year)))

mk1_tau <- round(mk1$estimates["tau"], 2)
mk1_p   <- ifelse(mk1$p.value < 0.001, "< 0.001", paste("=", round(mk1$p.value, 3)))

mk2_tau <- round(mk2$estimates["tau"], 2)
mk2_p   <- ifelse(mk2$p.value < 0.001, "< 0.001", paste("=", round(mk2$p.value, 3)))

# ── 4. PETTITT TESTS — FIX: use $estimate directly not names() ─
pett1      <- pettitt.test(df_clean$dim1)
pettitt_k1 <- as.integer(pett1$estimate) + min(df_clean$year) - 1   # was: names(pett1$estimate)
pett1_p    <- ifelse(pett1$p.value < 0.001, "< 0.001", paste("=", round(pett1$p.value, 3)))

pett2      <- pettitt.test(df2_clean$dim2)
pettitt_k2 <- as.integer(pett2$estimate) + min(df2_clean$year) - 1  # was: names(pett2$estimate)
pett2_p    <- ifelse(pett2$p.value < 0.001, "< 0.001", paste("=", round(pett2$p.value, 3)))

cat("Pettitt K1:", pettitt_k1, "| K2:", pettitt_k2, "\n")

# ── 5. SEGMENTED REGRESSION — PC1 (single breakpoint) ─────────
seg_fit1 <- segmented(
  lm(dim1 ~ year, data = df_clean),
  seg.Z = ~year,
  psi   = 1977
)
summary(seg_fit1)

df_clean$fitted1 <- fitted(seg_fit1)
bp1     <- as.data.frame(confint(seg_fit1))
bp1_est <- bp1[1, "Est."]
bp1_lo  <- bp1[1, "CI(95%).low"]
bp1_hi  <- bp1[1, "CI(95%).up"]

cat("PC1 breakpoint:", round(bp1_est),
    "| 95% CI:", round(bp1_lo), "-", round(bp1_hi), "\n")

# ── 6. SEGMENTED REGRESSION — PC2 (two breakpoints) ───────────
seg_fit2 <- segmented(
  lm(dim2 ~ year, data = df2_clean),
  seg.Z = ~year,
  psi   = c(1996, 2017)
)
summary(seg_fit2)

df2_clean$fitted2 <- fitted(seg_fit2)
bp2      <- as.data.frame(confint(seg_fit2))
bp2_est1 <- bp2[1, "Est."];  bp2_lo1 <- bp2[1, "CI(95%).low"];  bp2_hi1 <- bp2[1, "CI(95%).up"]
bp2_est2 <- bp2[2, "Est."];  bp2_lo2 <- bp2[2, "CI(95%).low"];  bp2_hi2 <- bp2[2, "CI(95%).up"]

cat("PC2 breakpoints:", round(bp2_est1), "&", round(bp2_est2), "\n")

# ── 7. PLOT PC1 ────────────────────────────────────────────────
p1 <- ggplot(df_clean, aes(x = year, y = dim1)) +

  annotate("rect",
           xmin = pettitt_k1 - 0.5, xmax = pettitt_k1 + 0.5,
           ymin = -Inf, ymax = Inf,
           fill = "#639922", alpha = 0.15) +
  annotate("text",
           x = pettitt_k1, y = Inf,
           label = paste0("Pettitt\n", pettitt_k1),
           vjust = 1.3, size = 2.8, colour = "#3B6D11",
           fontface = "italic", family = "serif") +

  annotate("rect",
           xmin = bp1_lo, xmax = bp1_hi,
           ymin = -Inf,   ymax = Inf,
           fill = "#D85A30", alpha = 0.10) +

  geom_vline(xintercept = bp1_est,
             colour = "#D85A30", linetype = "dashed", linewidth = 0.8) +

  annotate("text",
           x = bp1_est, y = Inf,
           label = as.character(round(bp1_est)),
           vjust = 1.4, hjust = -0.15, size = 2.8,
           colour = "#993C1D", fontface = "bold", family = "serif") +

  geom_point(colour = "#378ADD", size = 2, alpha = 0.7) +
  geom_line(aes(y = fitted1), colour = "#D85A30", linewidth = 1.1) +

  scale_x_continuous(breaks = seq(1970, 2025, by = 5)) +
  labs(
    title    = "Dimension 1 (PC1)",
    subtitle = paste0(
      "Mann-Kendall \u03c4 = ", mk1_tau, ", p ", mk1_p, "  |  ",
      "Pettitt p ", pett1_p, " (", pettitt_k1, ")  |  ",
      "Breakpoint: ", round(bp1_est),
      " (95% CI: ", round(bp1_lo), "\u2013", round(bp1_hi), ")"),
    x = NULL, y = "PC1 score") +
  theme_classic(base_size = 11, base_family = "serif") +
  theme(
    plot.title    = element_text(face = "bold", size = 11, colour = "#185FA5"),
    plot.subtitle = element_text(size = 8, colour = "grey40"),
    axis.text.x   = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1, size = 8),
    panel.border  = element_rect(colour = "grey70", fill = NA, linewidth = 0.5),
    axis.line     = element_blank()
  )

# ── 8. PLOT PC2 ────────────────────────────────────────────────
p2 <- ggplot(df2_clean, aes(x = year, y = dim2)) +

  annotate("rect",
           xmin = pettitt_k2 - 0.5, xmax = pettitt_k2 + 0.5,
           ymin = -Inf, ymax = Inf,
           fill = "#639922", alpha = 0.15) +
  annotate("text",
           x = pettitt_k2, y = Inf,
           label = paste0("Pettitt\n", pettitt_k2),
           vjust = 1.3, size = 2.8, colour = "#3B6D11",
           fontface = "italic", family = "serif") +

  annotate("rect", xmin = bp2_lo1, xmax = bp2_hi1,
           ymin = -Inf, ymax = Inf, fill = "#D85A30", alpha = 0.10) +
  annotate("rect", xmin = bp2_lo2, xmax = bp2_hi2,
           ymin = -Inf, ymax = Inf, fill = "#D85A30", alpha = 0.10) +

  geom_vline(xintercept = bp2_est1,
             colour = "#D85A30", linetype = "dashed", linewidth = 0.8) +
  geom_vline(xintercept = bp2_est2,
             colour = "#D85A30", linetype = "dashed", linewidth = 0.8) +

  annotate("text", x = bp2_est1, y = Inf,
           label = as.character(round(bp2_est1)),
           vjust = 1.4, hjust = -0.15, size = 2.8,
           colour = "#993C1D", fontface = "bold", family = "serif") +
  annotate("text", x = bp2_est2, y = Inf,
           label = as.character(round(bp2_est2)),
           vjust = 1.4, hjust = -0.15, size = 2.8,
           colour = "#993C1D", fontface = "bold", family = "serif") +

  geom_point(colour = "#1D9E75", size = 2, alpha = 0.7) +
  geom_line(aes(y = fitted2), colour = "#D85A30", linewidth = 1.1) +

  scale_x_continuous(breaks = seq(1970, 2025, by = 5)) +
  labs(
    title    = "Dimension 2 (PC2)",
    subtitle = paste0(
      "Mann-Kendall \u03c4 = ", mk2_tau, ", p ", mk2_p, "  |  ",
      "Pettitt p ", pett2_p, " (", pettitt_k2, ")  |  ",
      "Breakpoints: ", round(bp2_est1),
      " (95% CI: ", round(bp2_lo1), "\u2013", round(bp2_hi1), ")  &  ",
      round(bp2_est2), " (95% CI: ", round(bp2_lo2), "\u2013", round(bp2_hi2), ")"
    ), x = "Year", y = "PC2 score") +
  theme_classic(base_size = 11, base_family = "serif") +
  theme(
    plot.title    = element_text(face = "bold", size = 11, colour = "#0F6E56"),
    plot.subtitle = element_text(size = 8, colour = "grey40"),
    axis.text.x   = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1, size = 8),
    panel.border  = element_rect(colour = "grey70", fill = NA, linewidth = 0.5),
    axis.line     = element_blank())

# ── 9. COMBINE AND SAVE ────────────────────────────────────────
p_combined <- p1 / p2 +
  plot_annotation(
    caption = paste0(
      "Dashed lines = segmented regression breakpoints; ",
      "orange shading = 95% CI; green band = Pettitt changepoint.\n",
      "PC1: single breakpoint model. ",
      "PC2: two-breakpoint model."),
    theme = theme(
      plot.caption    = element_text(size = 7, colour = "grey50", family = "serif", hjust = 0),
      plot.background = element_rect(fill = "white", colour = NA) ))

p_combined
```

```{r}

```
